title: Act: Implement the Claude CLI adapter
summary: Create claude.go with Exec interface and Claude.Run
description: Create backend/worker/internal/provider/claude.go with Exec, Claude, NewClaude and Run that calls Exec with fixed args.
acceptance_criteria: Claude.Run calls Exec with name claude and constant args

steps.action: Declare interface Exec with Run(ctx context.Context, dir, name string, args []string) error. Declare const claudePrompt as a fixed instruction to implement the structured tasks in development/tasks. Declare type Claude struct{exec Exec}, NewClaude(e Exec) (*Claude, error) returning an error when e is nil, and (*Claude).Run(ctx, workDir) that calls exec.Run(ctx, workDir, "claude", []string{"-p", claudePrompt}) and returns 0 with the error wrapped as provider claude, or 0 and nil.
